description: The V2 server advertises channelVersion 2 and the credit-provider hook pair (preFund and postDistribute, four committed accounts each); the kit client opens with openWithHooks (discriminator 10), the compact hook configuration after the V1 open payload and the preFund bundle (target program, callback authority, extras) after the 14 V1 accounts. Control for every reject in this file. The open is the kit client's open action for the challenge the server issues; the server runs every check it makes before broadcasting.

spec.quote: Clients and servers MUST bind the selected network, channel version, `channelProgram`, and supported state, instruction, voucher and hook ABIs as one configured tuple.

description: A V2 server whose four hook slots are all disabled (channelHooks {}): account version selects the instruction family, so the open is still openWithHooks (10) with four zero slot tags and no callback bundle, never the V1 open. The open is the kit client's open action for the challenge the server issues; the server runs every check it makes before broadcasting.

spec.quote: The V1 layouts and encodings in this document MUST NOT be reused for V2 without an explicit ABI definition.

description: The hooked open's discriminator rewritten to the V1 open tag (1): the server rebuilds openWithHooks (10) and does not recognise the instruction; it must not fall back to V1 verification. Pair: session-v2-server-open-hooked-accept. Mutation: open discriminator set to 1. The open is the kit client's open action for the challenge the server issues; the server runs every check it makes before broadcasting.

spec.quote: Implementations MUST reject malformed or unsupported versions and MUST NOT retry a rejected V2 credential as V1.

description: A well-formed V1 open (discriminator 1, no hook configuration, 14 accounts) presented to the V2 server for the same channel: the credential's fields agree with the challenge, but the transaction funds an unhooked channel, which the server must refuse rather than accept without hooks. Pair: session-v2-server-open-hooked-accept. The open is the kit client's open action for the challenge the server issues; the server runs every check it makes before broadcasting.

spec.quote: Missing configuration or required accounts MUST fail, not disable hooks.

description: The hooked open's account list truncated to the 14 V1 accounts: the preFund bundle (target program, callback authority, four extras) is missing, so the instruction cannot run its mandatory callback. Pair: session-v2-server-open-hooked-accept. Mutation: open account list truncated to its first 14 accounts. The open is the kit client's open action for the challenge the server issues; the server runs every check it makes before broadcasting.

spec.quote: Recipient accounts and each hook's accounts MUST have an unambiguous partition.

description: The last byte of the compact hook configuration (the writable flag of the postDistribute descriptor's fourth account, the token program) flipped to writable: the committed policy differs from the one the merchant advertised. Pair: session-v2-server-open-hooked-accept. Mutation: open instruction data byte 0 from the end set to 1. spec.quote: Payer and sponsor MUST approve configuration at opening; merchants MUST accept its policy before providing service.

description: The kit client's hooked open (built for the V2 server's challenge) presented to the V1 server for the same channel: the V1 server expects the V1 open (1) and must not accept openWithHooks (10). Pair: session-v2-server-open-hooked-accept (the V2 server accepting the same open). The open is the kit client's open action for the challenge the server issues; the server runs every check it makes before broadcasting.
